leadText:
Nicolette (Japanese: シロミ Shiromi) is a character of the day who appeared in May's Egg-cellent Adventure. She works at a Kanto breeding center with her parents, Christopher and Jeannie, who raise Pokémon Eggs.

Nicolette confronted after stepped onto the property and was consequently zapped by the guarding . She quickly changed her manner after recognizing May as the winner of the Saffron City . She revealed that she had dreams of becoming a Pokémon Coordinator like May, but didn't think she could handle it. Her confidence took a hit after her was defeated by May's Munchlax. who learned during the match. May later caught up with Nicolette to talk things over while the pair polished Eggs together.

When attacked the farm with their mecha, Nicolette sent out her Vileplume to prevent the trio from leaving with the Eggs. After Team Rocket was defeated, she and the others watched as the glowing Egg hatched into a . She also gave an to May as a show of thanks for helping her out.
